findings.rationale: parse_ai_project accepts any recognized project block, but is_ai_project returns true only when a statistical_property, ai_migration, or observed_property line is present. Consequently a valid multi-declaration project containing only components, datasets, or raw blocks is misrouted into the single-document path by ai check (and similarly compat) and rejected or processed under the wrong contract.

Migration replacements are computed and semantically validated from an earlier read, but the commit routine receives only paths and replacement text and never verifies that each target still contains the planned source. A concurrent edit or migration between planning and rename is silently overwritten with stale output; the backup of the newer content is then deleted after success.

Domain scaffolding writes generated files directly into the final output tree one at a time. A later write failure leaves earlier files modified despite returning an error, and concurrent invocations targeting the same directory can interleave into a tree matching neither invocation because there is no staging, locking, or rollback.
